
# sc_grammar_parser.{cpp,hpp} are generated by Bison and committed, so normal users do not need Bison.
# Bison (3.8 or newer) is only needed, and only run, when sc_grammar.y differs from the version the
# committed files were generated from. That is tracked by a hash, as timestamps are unreliable in git.
set(SC_GRAMMAR_Y ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sc_grammar.y)
set(SC_GRAMMAR_HASH_FILE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sc_grammar.y.sha256)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${SC_GRAMMAR_Y})

# Line endings are removed before hashing, as git may check out CRLF on Windows.
# ...its always windows...
file(READ ${SC_GRAMMAR_Y} SC_GRAMMAR_Y_CONTENTS)
string(REPLACE "\r" "" SC_GRAMMAR_Y_CONTENTS "${SC_GRAMMAR_Y_CONTENTS}")
string(SHA256 SC_GRAMMAR_Y_HASH "${SC_GRAMMAR_Y_CONTENTS}")
file(STRINGS ${SC_GRAMMAR_HASH_FILE} SC_GRAMMAR_OLD_HASH LIMIT_COUNT 1)
string(STRIP "${SC_GRAMMAR_OLD_HASH}" SC_GRAMMAR_OLD_HASH)

if(NOT SC_GRAMMAR_Y_HASH STREQUAL SC_GRAMMAR_OLD_HASH)
    find_package(BISON 3.8 REQUIRED)
    message(STATUS "sc_grammar.y changed, regenerating the parser with Bison ${BISON_VERSION}")
    # Run from the source root so the #line directives hold repo relative paths.
    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${BISON_EXECUTABLE}
            -Wall
            -Werror
            --defines=langutils/sc_parser/src/sc_grammar_parser.hpp
            -o langutils/sc_parser/src/sc_grammar_parser.cpp
            langutils/sc_parser/src/sc_grammar.y
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}
        RESULT_VARIABLE SC_BISON_RESULT
    )
    if(NOT SC_BISON_RESULT EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Bison failed on sc_grammar.y")
    endif()
    file(WRITE ${SC_GRAMMAR_HASH_FILE} "${SC_GRAMMAR_Y_HASH}\n")
endif()

add_library(sc_parser STATIC 
    src/ast.cpp
    src/sc_parser.cpp
    src/sc_grammar_parser.cpp
    src/sc_grammar_impl.cpp
    src/tokenise.cpp
)


target_include_directories(sc_parser PUBLIC include)
target_include_directories(sc_parser PRIVATE src)
target_link_libraries(sc_parser PUBLIC sc_lexer sc_util sc_diagnostic)
#set_target_compiler_strict_errors(sc_parser)
set_property(TARGET sc_parser PROPERTY FOLDER Libs)

if(ENABLE_TESTSUITE)
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()


add_subdirectory(standalone)
